g.text: J3 cable maps to PIM724 SP/CE: 1=7, 2=1, 3=3/GP32, 4=6/GP33, 5=2/GP36. Qualified reserve defaults to zero.

g.desc: J3 cable maps to PIM724 SP/CE: 1=7, 2=1, 3=3/GP32, 4=6/GP33, 5=2/GP36. Qualified reserve defaults to zero.

g.text: Pico1715 optional reserve / electrical draft / NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: Pico1715 optional reserve / electrical draft / NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: D1 is the existing carrier diode. Omit the entire reserve branch for normal operation.

g.desc: D1 is the existing carrier diode. Omit the entire reserve branch for normal operation.

g.text: C1/C2: candidate 3 V EDLCs; U1/U2 shunt-clamp each cell near 2.495 V. Verify transient balance and clamp stability.

g.desc: C1/C2: candidate 3 V EDLCs; U1/U2 shunt-clamp each cell near 2.495 V. Verify transient balance and clamp stability.

g.text: Pico + PSRAM + SD are backed up. FPGA and host rails are NOT backed up. Verify off-state isolation of every crossing.

g.desc: Pico + PSRAM + SD are backed up. FPGA and host rails are NOT backed up. Verify off-state isolation of every crossing.

g.text: Use current-limited charging through R1; discharge bypasses R1 through F1/D3. Fuse and thermal selection are provisional.

g.desc: Use current-limited charging through R1; discharge bypasses R1 through F1/D3. Fuse and thermal selection are provisional.
